additional_info.subject: ID0381179-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / P3 170000342] Charger lost communication. CRM:00643000931
additional_info.body:
Dear Liz,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Shrey
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P3 170000342
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
qhDPeN
Problem Description
: Charger lost communication.
Troubleshooting
: After analyzing the logs, it was identified that there was a 20-minute downtime in OCPP connectivity. Additionally, during this period, the mobile connection was disconnected, possibly due to network issues. It was observed that while the OCPP backend was offline, a charging session was initiated. The authentication method in place is RFID and PIN for all outlets, where the tag is scanned and transmitted to the broker. Subsequently, the charge point should send an authorization request with the tag ID to the central system (backend) for confirmation. However, due to the OCPP disconnection, the charging attempt was unsuccessful. But after reboot it comes online and charging session was attempted and successful.
Please inform us if you have any additional questions to address. If not, we can proceed with closing this ticket.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0381179
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma
